children: TOKYO, October 22 (Reuters) - Foreign investors turned netsellers of Japanese stocks for the week ending on October 17, capital flows data showed on Thursday.    Foreigners sold a net 66.5 billion yen worth of shares inthe week through Oct. 17, after buying a net 3,545.5 billion yenin the week before that.    Japanese investors sold a net 161.6 billion yen of foreignbonds in the latest week after selling a net 339.9 billion yenthe week before.    Details of net investments were as follows (in billion yen):

FOREIGN INVESTMENT IN JAPAN:    (net)                                       stocks         bonds        bills    October 11 - October 17             -66.5      +1,454.2     -2,236.1     October 4  - October 10          +3,545.5r     +1,080.2r      +841.6
JAPANESE INVESTMENT ABROAD:    (net; a minus sign indicates net selling and inflows of funds into Japan)

stocks         bonds        bills    October 11 - October 17            +128.3        -161.6       -156.9     October 4  - October 10            -760.7r       -339.9r       +70.3     September 27 - October 3         +1,328.6        -344.7r      -156.0

Notes:    - An "r" denotes a revised figure.    - Bonds include beneficiary certificates.    - Figures are based on contracts and are rounded.    - The MOF's capital flows data can be found in English at:    http://www.mof.go.jp/international_policy/reference/itn_transactions_in_securities/week.pdf
